trigger: tick 1
text: Designate a place to dig with [d]. Dwarves dig into rock faces from the side.

trigger: no still exists and drink < 40 units
text: Dwarves need drink. Build a still [b > Workshops] and brew from plants.

trigger: no stockpile exists and items on the ground > 20
text: Set up a stockpile [z] so hauled goods have somewhere to go.

trigger: day 20 of spring, year 1
text: Winter comes in 60 days. Farms need soil or mud. Cave crops grow in the dark, but in a cold region a cave within two levels of the surface freezes in winter; three levels down stays warm.

trigger: no hearth and at least one dining hall or 5 bedrooms
text: A hearth makes a hall a home. Build one [b > Special] in your main hall.

trigger: a drink or seed stockpile exists without barrels or bags
text: Stockpiles need barrels for drink and bags for seeds. The carpenter makes barrels; the clothier makes bags.

trigger: a workshop is blocked because no barrel is empty
text: A brew needs an empty barrel, and a barrel that holds food or seed is not empty. Order a barrel at the carpenter's workshop.

trigger: a smelter or forge is blocked for fuel
text: Smelters and forges need fuel. A wood furnace makes charcoal from logs; coal seams burn too.

trigger: a living fortress dwarf has hunting enabled and no crossbow or bow exists
text: Hunters need a crossbow and bolts, or a bow and arrows.

trigger: a farm plot placement is refused
text: Farms need soil, mud left by water, or cave loam.

trigger: first harvest
text: Harvest returns one seed. Brewing and cooking do not.

trigger: a bedroom zone with tier bare exists for 3 days
text: A room needs walls or doors around it, a bed, and smooth stone to be worth sleeping in.

trigger: first ThreatWarning, or the first fortress dwarf wounded by an animal; again at a raid's arrival (RaidArrived of a raid, a siege or bandits) or an ambush sprung while the alert is Calm, unless it showed within HINT_ALERT_REPEAT_DAYS
text: Click a door and choose Lock on alert. Then [m] and [3] raise the Hearth alert: civilians go to the hearth and those doors lock, but a dwarf in dire need still goes out to eat, drink or sleep, and the medics still tend the wounded.

trigger: day 14 of summer, year 1, no depot
text: Build a trade depot [b > Special] before the caravan arrives.

trigger: first serious wound to a dwarf of the fortress with no hospital
text: A hospital zone needs a bed, a chest, cloth and thread. Brightleaf treats infection.

trigger: first ImmigrationSkipped
text: Immigrants come at the turn of the season when hall spirit is Content. Good rooms, meals and drink raise it.

trigger: first raid ended
text: A drawbridge over a channel is the surest gate. Build a lever inside [b], click it, press [i] and click the bridge; [y] pulls it.

trigger: first cage trap built
text: Cage traps catch anything smaller than a wyrm. Caged beasts can be tamed at a kennel or sold.

trigger: first DoorBroken
text: Trollkin break doors. Walls and raised bridges hold.

trigger: first VeinFound deepsilver
text: Deepsilver lies beside the Sea of Fire. Taking it wakes the Hollow. The threats panel shows the Deep gauge.

trigger: first cavern 2 breach
text: A forge over channeled magma needs no fuel. Build it of magma-safe stone.

trigger: first cavern 3 breach
text: The third cavern lies open. Deepsilver lies within two tiles of magma, at the bottom of the world: the Sea of Fire's rim and the magma pools of the deep caverns.

trigger: DayPassed: more than IDLE_HAULER_WARNING items want hauling and fewer than HAULER_WARNING_MIN_WORKERS dwarves have hauling enabled
text: Items are waiting to be hauled. Enable hauling for more dwarves in the labors panel.

trigger: a dig designation exists and no living dwarf has mining enabled; hourly
text: No one has mining enabled. Turn it on in Labors [l].

trigger: from day 3 of the first spring, no squad exists
text: Wild beasts will come. Dig a hall into rock, put a door on it, click the door and choose Lock on alert. Make a squad in [m] and arm it with iron spears: clubs lose to boars. Order a kill when a beast comes.

trigger: first AnimalSpawned of a dangerous species while the fortress has a shelter (a hearth hall, a built door or a bedroom zone)
text: A beast that hunts dwarves is near. [m] then [3] raises the Hearth alert: civilians go to the hearth and doors set to Lock on alert shut. [n] then [2] shows where it is.

trigger: first AnimalSpawned of a dangerous species while the fortress has no shelter
text: A beast that hunts dwarves is near. [m] then [3] raises the Hearth alert once your hall has a door: before that there is nowhere to shelter, and the dwarves work on in the open. [n] then [2] shows where it is.

trigger: edible items in stock fall below HINT_FOOD_DAYS days for the population, hourly
text: Food is running low. Check the farm plots' crops [z], order meals at a kitchen, and gather plants [d].

trigger: the first Starving of the fortress for hunger, after that day's starving line
text: Dwarves are starving, and there is food at hand: {food}.

trigger: a job remains blocked unreachable for a whole day from first hourly observation
text: Jobs are blocked: no path. Check for doors, water and undug rock.

trigger: glowcap seeds in stock
text: Glowcap grows in the dark under a glowstone lamp: order one at a jeweler's ([o], 'Glowstone lamp'), then place it [b > Furniture > Statue] in the middle of a dark plot.

trigger: a runeforge is placed
text: The runeforge burns vials, not coal.

trigger: a runeforge is built
text: A staff is a stone on a stick: the stone is the spell, the dwarf is the fuel.

trigger: a wand or a staff in stock
text: A wand is quick and soft; a shod staff is slow and hard.

trigger: a sanctum zone exists
text: Build the sanctum in stone.

trigger: a dwarf of the fortress has rune of their own
text: Iron drinks the rune: a runecaster in mail recovers slowly.

trigger: a draught in stock
text: One draught, then three days' rest.

trigger: a dwarf eats a raw plant while a work order for a draught brewed from plants stands
text: Hungry dwarves ate the plants a draught was waiting for. Order the draught before the crop ripens, and its job takes the first of the harvest.

trigger: a stockpile with the cellar setting on is not a working cellar (hourly)
text: A cellar must be dark and between 2 and 14 °C. Oak barrels age in a year, other wood in two.

trigger: first Slept on the floor with a pallet's materials (cloth, wool, fiber, straw or reeds) in stock
text: A pallet needs no workshop: build one from cloth or straw and nobody sleeps on the floor.

trigger: first drying_rack built
text: A rack dries what it holds. Outdoors it dries twice as fast in clear weather, and not at all in rain.

trigger: a built hive with too few flowers in reach
text: Bees need flowers: three within six tiles of the hive. Look for a meadow.

trigger: first glass floor built over open space
text: A glass floor is a skylight: crops below grow in every season, as warm as the rock around them.

trigger: first caged spider placed in a cage building
text: The spider does not need feeding. Nobody has asked it.

trigger: the first food item of the fortress turns stale
text: Food rots: meals and raw food keep two or three weeks. Barrels in a food stockpile slow it four times; smoked or salted meat keeps. Cook, farm and fish for more.

trigger: first cavern breach
text: A cavern lies open to the fortress, and what lives there can walk in. Wall the opening off [b > Constructions] or hang a door in it set to Lock on alert.

trigger: a panel's own letter acts where that letter also opens a panel (§ Panels)
text: Inside a panel its own letters come first. Esc, then a letter, opens another panel.

trigger: the first designation, zone, building or work order made while the fortress is paused and has not run since it was entered (embarked or loaded); not while the tutorial runs
text: Time is paused, so nothing happens yet. [Space] runs the fortress, [+] and [-] change the speed.

trigger: the first miserable line of the fortress, after it (MoodTierChanged)
text: A miserable dwarf works slower and may sulk. The Mood panel [e] says what helps.

trigger: the living dwarves of the fortress reach its population cap (21), hourly
text: The fortress has reached its population cap: [p] raises it. The idle wait in the hearth hall. For more to do, put a squad on Train [m], dig down to the caverns and what the deep holds, or build a runeforge [b > Workshops] for runecraft.
